name: callforme
description: Gives your AI agent a phone: it calls businesses in the US and Canada, works the phone menu, waits on hold, asks your agent mid-call when the business needs something and returns answers plus a transcript. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1. Pay per call, $1 per answered call including the first 2 minutes.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and connect (dynamic client registration, nothing to enter). The first real call returns a link to add credit: $1 per answered call including the first 2 minutes; a demo line works with no account.

tools.name: place_call
tools.description: Place a phone call to a US or Canadian business and get answers back.

tools.name: wait_for_setup
tools.description: Wait while the user finishes adding credit after place_call returns a setup link.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Follow a call: status, the business's pending question, answers, live transcript and outcome.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Send a message into a live call when the business asks something.

tools.name: redial
tools.description: Call the same business again with changes: a missing detail, a new question, another day.

tools.name: share_call
tools.description: Make a public, read-only page for a finished call, when the user asks.

tools.name: plan_call
tools.description: Preview the opening line and what the business will probably ask, before placing a call.

tools.name: call_around
tools.description: Call several businesses of a kind with the same goal and compare results.

tools.name: get_batch
tools.description: Follow a call_around batch: totals, a results table and open questions.

tools.name: stop_batch
tools.description: Stop dialing new places in a batch.

tools.name: find_business
tools.description: Find a business's phone number, address, hours, local time and rating.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List recent calls with status, answers and outcome.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Show the balance, auto-reload setting, recent spend and a link to add credit.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Show what a call costs and how credit and auto-reload work.
